text:
Elaine (docs): Quick sync — PR #482 updates the SDK examples for Console embedding and also renames the breadcrumbs metric key. Need a link sweep + dashboards/schema check before we merge. @Sara can you own redirects and link updates? @Miguel can you confirm runtime/backcompat?
Sara (devex): Yep, I can do redirects. Can you paste the PR link and the old/new metric keys here?
Elaine (docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Old metric: `console.breadcrumb_latency_ms`
New metric: `console.breadcrumbs.latency_ms`
Also the SDK samples in python/ts reference the old key in two places.
Miguel (eng-runtime): I can confirm the runtime will accept the new key. We'll ship an alias so old keys work for ~2 weeks, then cutover. I'll add rollout notes to the infra change. Which dashboards do we need to update?
Elaine (docs): "Breadcrumbs Overview" and "Latency Cost Matrix" in Console, plus the cost breakdown sample in docs/console/costs.md and the inline SDK examples under docs/sdk/python and docs/sdk/ts.
Tim (sre): FYI changing metric names may require reindexing saved queries for the dashboard service. If so, I'll need a short maintenance window. @Miguel can you provide a migration script or a one-liner to apply updates?
Miguel (eng-runtime): Yep — pushing a tiny helper. Example dry-run:```bash
python tools/migrate_metric_keys.py 
  --from console.breadcrumb_latency_ms 
  --to console.breadcrumbs.latency_ms 
  --dry-run
```This will print affected dashboards/saved queries. Remove `--dry-run` to commit.
Sara (devex): Nice. Plan: 1) add Netlify _redirects entries for the old links 2) update docs links and inline snippets 3) run link-checker and backfill samples. I can do that tomorrow EOD.
Elaine (docs): Great — please also update the SDK snippet comments to mention the alias window.
deploy-bot: docs site build queued for commit 9f3b2a1 (PR 482)
deploy-bot: build succeeded — preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/ (staging)
Sara (devex): Ran the link checker locally — found 5 occurrences of the old metric in embedded code blocks and one stale dashboard link. Will open a PR to fix them after Miguel's migration script lands.
Elaine (docs): One more ask: add a short note in the release notes explaining how the new breadcrumb metric maps to cost/latency breakdowns so customers don't misinterpret numbers.
Miguel (eng-runtime): Will add a release note and a short section in the CHANGELOG. Quantization/profiles unaffected.
Tim (sre): I can reserve Thu 09:30 PT for a brief reindex/update window. If we keep it under 15 minutes, I can do it without major customer impact.
Elaine (docs): SGTM — thanks all :thumbsup: I'll tag the docs PR with `docs:hold` until redirects + migration script are merged.
Sara (devex): Cool, I'll follow up with the PR link once it's up and run the CI link-checker on staging.
Miguel (eng-runtime): Pushing migration helper now, will update this thread when it's live.
Tim (sre): Thanks — ping me when Miguel's script is ready and I'll block the time.
Elaine (docs): Closing loop here — appreciate the quick turnaround.
